name: com.example.demo
comment: Root package for the demo Spring Boot application and core server management utilities.

name: com.example.demo.DemoApplication
comment: Main entry point for the Demo Spring Boot application.

methods.name: main
methods.comment: Launches the Spring Boot application context.

name: com.example.demo.RmiServerManager
comment: Utility for managing the lifecycle of Java RMI registries and preventing port binding conflicts.

methods.name: getOrCreateRegistry
methods.comment: Gets an existing locally created registry or creates a new RMI registry on the specified port.

methods.name: getLocallyCreatedRegistries
methods.comment: Returns an unmodifiable view of locally created and tracked registries.

methods.name: unexportRegistry
methods.comment: Unexports a locally tracked RMI registry.

methods.name: unexportRegistry
methods.comment: Unexports a locally tracked RMI registry by port.

methods.name: unexportAllRegistries
methods.comment: Unexports all locally tracked RMI registries.

methods.name: configureSecurityFilters
methods.comment: Configures serialization security filters for RMI.

name: com.example.demo.controller
comment: REST controllers and API layer components for managing application resources.

name: com.example.demo.dto
comment: Data transfer objects for request and response payloads.

name: com.example.demo.exception
comment: Exception classes and global error handling advice.

name: com.example.demo.model
comment: Domain model entities and data structures for the demo application.

name: com.example.demo.repository
comment: Data access repositories and Spring Data JPA interfaces for database persistence.

name: com.example.demo.service
comment: Business service layer components and transaction management.
